denominator.description: Count of distinct eligible entities entering or present in the declared source state for the same cohort and window.
denominator.eligibility: Entity belongs to the exact declared source-state cohort and reporting window.
denominator.expression: count(distinct entity_id where eligible=true and source_state cohort is fixed)
denominator.name: eligible_entities_entering_source_state

eligibility_criteria: The source and target states are declared before computation.
The eligible denominator and cohort window are version-bound.
evidence_requirements: Exact source and target state definitions.
Source lineage digests and exact repository revision.
exclusions: Expired authorizations are excluded from active pending cohorts.
Duplicate source records at the declared grain are rejected rather than deduplicated silently.
metrics.grain: One declared lifecycle transition pair per reporting window and controlled dimension set.
guardrails: External-action and approval-boundary violations must remain exactly zero.
A denominator change requires a metric-version change.
No metric result may authorize a lifecycle transition.
insufficiency_conditions: A mandatory source is unavailable or stale.
The eligible denominator is zero or undefined.
Transition lineage or exact repository revision is missing.

numerator.description: Count of eligible entities that reached the declared target state inside the reporting window.
numerator.eligibility: Entity has an authoritative source, valid lineage, and is eligible for the declared transition.
numerator.expression: count(distinct entity_id where eligible=true and transition_to=target_state)
numerator.name: eligible_entities_reaching_target_state

metrics.purpose: Measure where eligible governed work advances, waits, expires, fails, or requires operator intervention without treating raw stage counts as conversion.
metrics.title: Governed Progression Rate

denominator.description: All evidence records required for the exact evaluated scope.
denominator.eligibility: Requirement is applicable to the evaluated scope and not explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE.
denominator.expression: count(required evidence record in exact scope catalog)
denominator.name: all_required_evidence_records

eligibility_criteria: The evaluated scope and its exact evidence requirements are declared.
Every required record has a source locator and content digest.
evidence_requirements: Lineage and freshness evidence for every applicable record.
exclusions: Optional evidence is excluded from the denominator unless the metric version says otherwise.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires an explicit reason and governing rule.
metrics.formula: (numerator / denominator) * 100; any blocking finding forces FAIL; unavailable mandatory source => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
metrics.grain: One governed evaluation scope, required-evidence catalog version, and reporting window.
guardrails: Hash-chain, immutability, secret, or privacy violations must equal zero.
Stale evidence cannot produce PASS or HEALTHY.
Blocking findings cannot be averaged into a passing aggregate.
insufficiency_conditions: A required record has missing or invalid lineage.
Freshness cannot be computed from trusted timestamps.

numerator.description: Required evidence records that pass schema, lineage, digest, and freshness validation.
numerator.eligibility: Record is required by the exact scope and evidence catalog version.
numerator.expression: count(required evidence record where lineage_valid=true and freshness=FRESH)
numerator.name: valid_fresh_required_evidence_records

metrics.purpose: Determine whether required evidence is complete, lineage-valid, and fresh enough for an operator or readiness decision.
metrics.title: Evidence Completeness and Freshness

denominator.description: Count of predictions having sufficient real governed outcome evidence and an eligible sample cohort.
denominator.eligibility: Outcome evidence is present, fresh, non-structural, and meets sample-sufficiency policy.
denominator.name: all_eligible_predictions_with_governed_outcomes

eligibility_criteria: Prediction and outcome definitions are immutable and versioned.
The cohort meets the minimum sample size before any aggregate is reported.
evidence_requirements: Real governed outcome receipts linked to predictions.
Exact score and outcome definition versions.
exclusions: Structural repository evidence is not an outcome.
Missing or inferred outcomes are excluded and reported as insufficient evidence.
metrics.formula: (numerator / denominator) * 100; inactive until minimum sample size and governed outcome evidence both pass
metrics.grain: One score definition version, outcome definition version, cohort, and reporting window.
guardrails: No autonomous threshold or behavior change is permitted.
Small samples and missing outcomes must report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Production or business-success claims require separate runtime and outcome receipts.
insufficiency_conditions: Real governed outcome evidence is unavailable.
The minimum sample size is not met.
Prediction or outcome definition versions are missing.

numerator.description: Count of sufficiently evidenced predictions whose declared class matches the later governed outcome.
numerator.eligibility: Prediction and outcome are linked, version-bound, and independently evidenced.
numerator.name: calibrated_predictions_matching_governed_outcomes

metrics.purpose: Define a future calibration contract comparing internal score bands with governed downstream outcomes without activating autonomous threshold changes.
metrics.title: Decision-Quality Calibration
